headline: Radev: Foreign Investment in Bulgaria Doubles, Investor Confidence Rises
summary: Prime Minister Rumen Radev said foreign direct investment in Bulgaria rose 100% this year compared with the same period last year. He spoke at a groundbreaking for a new production facility at Intuitive's plant in Parvomay.
why: Foreign direct investment funds factories and jobs and signals investor confidence in an economy. Manufacturing expansions by multinationals shape regional supply chains.
